name: Super Metroid

assets.needs: Super Metroid (Japan, USA) (En,Ja) SNES ROM. Picked once with the document picker on first launch; the app copies it to sm.smc.
assets.notes: The first start right after import shows a black screen; later starts work.

settings.in_app_menu: Bottom screen > Setup tab (status strip on map, hide main HUD, save states, clear map markers, autosave on exit). Everything else only in sm.ini.
settings.summary: sm.ini (snesrev format) is copied from the APK on first launch and read once at game start: NewRenderer, EnhancedMode7, NoSpriteLimits, IgnoreAspectRatio, LinearFiltering, audio rate/buffer, DisableFrameDelay, Autosave, gamepad map, quicksave/quickload combos (L1+R1+Start / L1+R1+Back). Android ignores OutputMethod (always SDL_Renderer), Fullscreen and WindowSize; AutoRun currently does nothing (gameplay runs on the bundled SNES emulator core). Bottom-screen toggles are in SharedPreferences 'secondscreen'. No widescreen option.

controls: SDL2 gamepad. On the Thor, A/B are remapped to the Nintendo-style layout in main.c, and L2/R2 cycle the armed ammo (handled in MainActivity.dispatchKeyEvent, keycodes 104/105). Quicksave L1+R1+Start, quickload L1+R1+Back (slot 0). No touch controls for gameplay; the bottom screen is touch.
display: Game on the top screen (immersive fullscreen, 4:3). Bottom screen is an Android Presentation with Map (live explored map, HP/ammo strip, markers), Items and Setup tabs. Known issue from the README: an occasional black screen when launched right after another game from Cocoon; closing and relaunching fixes it.
saves: /sdcard/Android/data/com.raekwon.supermetroid/files/saves/ (sm.srm in-game SRAM plus sm.srm.bak, save%d.sav save states, autosave_thumb.bin).
notes: The v1.1 (Super.Metroid.Dual.Screen.apk) and v1.2 (app-debug.apk) release assets share SHA-256 57dddd0b...; v1.2 (2026-09-08) is the latest. The author has stopped work on this repo and moved to MetroidArch, a dual-screen RetroArch fork (https://github.com/Raekwon1603/RetroArch, branch metroidarch-dual-screen, package com.metroidarch.app.aarch64). Gameplay runs on snesrev/sm's bundled 65816/SPC700 emulator core rather than the decompiled C. Known open bug: rapid uncharged beam shots are silent after the first.
verified: Device: version, install time, data dir, ROM location. APK: SHA-256 against GitHub releases, sm.ini asset, jadx of MainActivity/SetupActivity/MapStatusView (paths, prefs keys), libmain.so strings. GitHub: README, src/config.c and src/main.c (ini parsing, sm.user.ini precedence, chdir to external files dir). Not checked: running the game.
